observed_legacy.DNS: Synchronous getaddrinfo; worker checks elapsed after it returns. Worker alone cannot preempt a blocked resolver.
observed_legacy.TCP_TLS: Remaining worker 10-second budget used; not a fixed 5-second TCP contract.
observed_legacy.read: Each loop recomputes worker remaining budget; not a dedicated 15-second idle-read contract.
observed_legacy.Job: Kill-on-close and active-process limit 4; no independent wall-clock job-time deadline set in this code. Parent finite wait/cleanup is responsible.

options.conclusion: Preserves old contract but cannot be called the exact new 5s connect/15s idle-read contract; no live qualification transfer.
A finite monotonic worker/parent/storage/cleanup hierarchy is necessary. Socket timeouts alone cannot bound blocking DNS or endless successful small reads.
Recommended draft: separate exact 2-URL worker with fixed identity, total wall deadline, bounded storage and attempt-first consumption. Implementation/OS qualification needs separate approval.

DNS_TLS_handshake_bounds: DNS must be covered by the external parent watchdog; TLS has a proposed 5s cap. Actual cancellation/descendant cleanup remains dynamic proof.
storage_budget: Hash, fsync and readback share 10s and must remain inside the worker 60s deadline. No reset per storage operation.
repeated_read_budget: 15s is per blocked read, not whole-body duration. Every call also gets min(idle cap, remaining global budget).
session_total_window: Not inferred from 5+15; a future exact subset/session time window and total budget require approval.
